text:
Maya Chen: Proposal: ship a focused Optimize toolkit MVP for pilots. Include: adaptive batching (route-level enable), prefix KV cache, and eval-triggered regression alerts. Exclude automated quant recs from runtime; provide a labeled 'experimental advisory' PDF instead. Goal: pilot in ~2 weeks.

Diego Alvarez: Strong 👍 for tight scope. Need explicit, operational launch gates (econ, latency, alert quality) so SRE/sales can greenlight pilots.

Priya Nair: From runtime: adaptive batching + KV cache are low-risk. Main integration work: per-route feature flags and a telemetry hook to measure before/after token cost. Quant recs require dataset ingestion + offline eval infra; defer.

Ben Holt: Suggest measurable gates: econ: median token cost reduction ≥15% on pilot routes over 7d; latency: user p95 ≤ baseline +12%; alerting: seed tests precision ≥80% and FPR ≤10%. Add an early rollback rule if 72h econ <8%.

Samira Rahman: Customer-facing note: pilots (NoteFlow & BeaconDocs) asked for quant guidance. They'll accept an "experimental advisory" PDF with config snippets if we clearly label risks. I can draft and send.

Maya Chen: Good. Samira to own advisory doc and customer comms. Diego to own launch checklist. Priya to spike feature-flag + admission-control configs. Ben to wire econ dashboards and the 72h auto-rollback.

Priya Nair: Spike plan (this week): implement a minimal admission control config and per-route toggle. Example config we'll use for canary testing:
```json
{"max_wait_ms":20,"min_batch_size":3,"enable_per_route":true}
```
We'll run synthetic traces then a tiny canary.

deploy-bot: Canary cluster provisioned: optimize-pilot-canary (us-west-2) x3 nodes. Monitoring dashboards: /d/optimize/pilot-canary. Alerts to #eng-oncall.

Diego Alvarez: Launch gates summary to include: 1) bench on 3 representative prompt sets with econ >=15% median, 2) seeded regressions to validate alert precision/FPR, 3) per-route toggle + playbook for immediate rollback, 4) customer-facing advisory PDF for quantization.

Ben Holt: Operational rule: if a pilot route's first 72h econ improvement <8% vs baseline -> auto-disable batching for that route and create a PagerDuty incident to triage. Track user-visible latencies too.

Maya Chen: Decision: MVP = adaptive batching + prefix cache + eval alerts; quantization recommendations = advisory PDF only. Action owners assigned, timeline ~2 weeks. We'll reconvene after the infra spike. :rocket:
